items.title: Fake CAPTCHA Scams
items.summary: New variant of an old scam: Use the framing of a CAPTCHA to get an unsuspecting user to download and run a malicious program.

items.title: My Talk at DEF CON
items.summary: Last month, I gave a talk at DEF CON on AI hacking: what happens when AIs become hackers. It’s a combination of the potentialities I raised in my 2022 book A Hacker’s Mind and the lessons we’re learning from current AI models engaging in hacking behavior.
